qualification.interpretation: The local PPA head was not fully green before reconciliation. The merged branch fixes the procedure-pointer ABI issue. It also exposed that the WU04C/WU04D owner-commit assertions had no qualified generic numerical, temporal, or storage policy and that the nonzero prescribed-root owner assertion exceeded its qualified temporal-provider envelope. After rescoping those assertions, WU01 reaches the independent ATM02 owner runtime blocker. This branch is therefore a safe synchronization point, not production-admitted canonical.
